Subject: Next steps: 30-min product preview & infra owner availability

Hi Sam / Nicole —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap of the parts that looked like the highest priority for Avery:
- Evaluate inference cost at 99th percentile latency for your 8k-context summaries
- Support for VPC/private deployment and KMS-managed keys for PII workloads
- Integration points: S3-backed prompt stores + our existing auth layer

We’d love to move to a short 30-minute product preview (compact demo + Q&A) with two goals: 1) show the cost/latency profile on a sample prompt set, and 2) loop in your infra/ops owner to validate network and KMS assumptions.

Could you pick one of these bracketed options? I offered ranges to make it easier to match multiple calendars:
- Option A: Wed 4/6 or Thu 4/7 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT OR 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Option B: Mon 4/11 — 11:30 AM–12:30 PM PT OR 4:00–5:00 PM PT
- Option C: Tue 4/12 — 8:00–9:00 AM PT OR 3:30–4:30 PM PT

If none of those work, please tell us two windows that do and we’ll mirror them. We’ll aim to keep it to 30 minutes and include a short runbook so your infra lead can validate the network/KMS pieces in the next 10 minutes.

Attached: discovery_notes-avery-20270404.pdf (summary + open questions).

Thanks — I’ve looped in Marissa (ops scheduling) and Soojin (solutions engineer) on cc to help lock the calendar once you pick a bracket.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
